body: I noticed a cold draft seeping in through the partially open door, chilling my spine. My heart clenched at the thought of anyone venturing into this space without me. I took a deep breath, feeling the protective warmth expand within. Before long, my fingers found the latch on the lock. With one firm pull, it clicked shut, sealing off the vulnerability. Inside, I could hear soft murmurs from someone else who hadn't heard me come in. They turned to face me, their eyes wide with surprise. In that moment, I felt both relief for not being alone and determination to shield them from future risks too.
